opening.argument: The speaker reports receiving a $5 gift card by phone and applying its value to a household purchase. Lowe's receipts show $5 discounts and the resulting totals, grounding the account in ordinary couponing rather than a financial scheme. The speaker also tells viewers to text “SPRING” to 78133 to seek the gift-card offer. That instruction is an external offer, and its validity for viewers remains unverified. The observable purchase discounts support the limited point that the video demonstrates promotional savings; they do not establish that everyone who texts will receive a gift card.
